project_description: Detect coding-agent session compaction from proxy-observable canonical request/response flow, emit typed started/completed lifecycle observations with explicit evidence quality, and let feature listeners subscribe through a fail-open SDK observer seam. Use protocol-native signals first, deterministic versioned agent signatures second, and a conservative cross-request history heuristic only as fallback; coalesce multi-call compaction transactions, retain only bounded hashes/metadata keyed by authoritative A-leg continuity, and do not use agent hooks, prompt-content persistence, an LLM classifier, routing mutation, or new database state.
